profile.headline: IT Professional
profile.summary:
Solid knowledge in the development of web applications and web services with a path of 9 years, focusing on user requirements.  Strong problem solving and time management skills with proven success at handling multiple responsibilities in high-pressure environments. Fluent in English, Spanish (native-speaker).

Skills: 

- Ability to work as part of a collaborative virtual environment. 
- Ability to work in team, driving synergy and effective communication.
- Large capacity for analysis and resolution of complex problems.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
- Migrated over 7 based ASP applications to MVC .NET which improved apps speed by 20% after implementation.
- Using Bootstrap and MVC I built out an Investment Financial application for the bank that allowed the Officer to monitor and balance the investment accounts portfolio based on pre set type of risk, type of security and region. Also provided a simulation tool that allowed the officer to simulate changes on the account portfolio, boosting investments by 18%.
- Created 3 web apps for customer and contact management that allowed business handle over 5,000 tickets monthly.
- Cut merge conflicts by 15% using GIT for version control and collaboration.
- Mentored 2 front-end developers on the team on MVC and Bootstrap.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · SQL · Oracle · VB.NET · TeamCity · Git

positions.title: Business analyst
positions.description:
My responsibilities were mainly based on: 
1- Design, development and implementation of NET-based applications to support business. 
2- Design and development of reports using "Reports Builder" tool.
3- Administration Tool Smart Plant Materials.
4- Study of new opportunities for improvement and new technology solutions that support the business.
positions.insights: Skills: IT Business Analysis · SQL · Technical Support · Oracle Report Builder

positions.title: Business analyst
positions.description:
My responsibilities were mainly based on: 
1- Design, development and implementation of NET-based applications to support business. 
2- Active participation in gathering information with business users. 
3- Lead international and local projects. 
4- Study of new opportunities for improvement and new technology solutions that support the business.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · C# · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Internships
positions.description:
-   Design and development of a service catalog using the tool. "NET" Microsoft and SQL Server 2008, following the ITIL methodology.
-   Design and development of the database for the service catalog.
-   Development of application documentation (User Manual, Document Design and Data Dictionary).
-   Development of the application tests.
